scope: Primary-authority classification only. No finite-mass contour and no BSM response/enhancement scan.

primary_sources.role: preferred later primary authority under frozen source order

facts.force_strength_relation: alpha_g approximately +/- 1.2536e36 epsilon^2; sign depends on spin convention
facts.nm_ir_mapping: For NMIR L_int = g_BL V_mu J_{B-L}^mu, the coefficient multiplying the pure B-L current is g_BL = e |epsilon_{B-L}|. Fayet g'' is a distinct UV-normalized extra-U(1) coupling and must not be identified with NMIR g_BL.
facts.range_scope: long-range/asymptotic; published MICROSCOPE result is stated for range large compared with Earth scale, not as a reproducible finite-mass contour

primary_sources.role: supporting earlier primary authority for range semantics

facts.yukawa_potential: V_U proportional epsilon_{B-L}^2 N1 N2 exp(-r/lambda_U)/r (eq. 22)
facts.range_scope: lambda_U assumed infinite or somewhat larger than Earth diameter for quoted bound; sensitivity rapidly degrades for smaller lambda_U, especially well below satellite altitude 710 km
facts.finite_range_authority: No exact numerical finite-range contour/table sufficient for NMIR materialization was identified; the qualitative damping discussion is not used as a finite-mass bound.

decision: Freeze 0079a for the strict long-range/asymptotic m_V -> 0 limit only, using the later 2019 primary bound and g_BL=e|epsilon_{B-L}|. Do not invent a finite-mass Yukawa turn-off. Continue searching a separate finite-range low-mass family after 0079a.
